theory: The corpus is versioned mathematical content with provenance, review identities, and explicit retirement. Measurements are derived elsewhere so statement edits and experimental outcomes remain different facts.
instead_of: One mutable table of statements and scores would make content curation silently rewrite the experimental population.

absorption.rationale: Content growth fits directly; a second formal language needs a different statement assembly contract.

world_mapping.rationale: Entries, occurrences, reviews and retirement are distinct curation facts.

abstraction.rationale: Shared identity and one catalog keep measurements from redefining their source content.

justification.rationale: Binders and conclusion are separated precisely to avoid pretending the package parses Lean.

honest_limits.rationale: Mechanical validity cannot establish truth or faithfulness; expected truth remains authored metadata.

rehearsals.requirement: Curate another statement in an existing class
rehearsals.why: Populate Entry and provenance and run the same catalog checks.

rehearsals.requirement: Store Isabelle and Lean as equivalent alternatives
rehearsals.why: The contract assembles one Lean declaration from its fields.

rehearsals.requirement: Retire an incorrect statement without reusing its identifier
rehearsals.why: The catalog has explicit registry and tombstone checks.
